title: BETARGET : Randomized trial of individualizing BETA-lactam taRGET combining therapeutic drug monitoring, minimal inhibitory concentration and model-based dose adjustment, in Intensive Care Units patients with gram negative bacilli infection
official: BETARGET : Randomized trial of individualizing BETA-lactam taRGET combining therapeutic drug monitoring, minimal inhibitory concentration and model-based dose adjustment, in Intensive Care Units patients with gram negative bacilli infection
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the impact of an individualized strategy (BETARGET strategy including MIC, TDM and model-based adjustement) for beta-lactam therapy in ICU NGB-infected patients on the ICU free days at day 28.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years
2. Hospitalization in ICU
3. Sepsis
4. Enterobacterales or non-fermenting Gram negative bacilli microbiological documentation
5. Beta-lactam antibiotic therapy with CEFOTAXIME, CEFTAZIDIME, CEFEPIME, PIPERACILLINE, PIPERACILLINE-TAZOBACTAM, MEROPENEME, AMOXICILLINE, CEFTAZIDIME-AVIBACTAM
6. Information of the patient or a relative/legal representative, or use of the emergency procedure
Exclusion criteria:
1. Allergy to beta-lactams
2. Urinary infection
3. Plurimicrobial infection
4. “Complex” infection: central nervous system infection, bone or joint infection
5. Protected person (adults legally protected (under judicial protection, guardianship or supervision), person deprived of their liberty, pregnant woman, lactating woman and minor)
6. Impossibility to measure the MIC of the defined bacteria
7. Absence of coverage by a social security scheme
